title: OL-20261112-93: PICKS-1: suggestions re-rank from what people choose
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** 20 recorded builds with ui=thread
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::PICKS-1
**Status:** open

Every build stores the ideas and additions the person picked (KV key picks); /api/suggest ranks by those counts with no curation. Next: measure pick rate per suggestion source (daily, pool, model) and drop sources that are never picked.
